messages:
sam-support: Hi team — customer reported their free trial was blocked when they applied promo SPRINGFREE. They say account created minutes ago. Account ID: acct_98f3a, email: julia.marketing+promo@gmail.com, IP: 45.77.12.9 (claimed CA), UA: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64). Customer wants it escalated for manual grant.

maria-risk: Thanks. I pulled the risk record. Automated reason: abuse_risk_high. Triggers: disposable_email_pattern, vpn_exit_ip, promo_reuse_history. Risk score: 0.92.

risk-bot: [automated] risk_eval -> score=0.92; rules_triggered=[disposable_email, vpn_detected, promo_reuse]; note="email alias used with known disposable provider list v3"; rule_events=3

sam-support: Can we get a quick breakdown so we can tell the customer next steps? They pushed back saying they are legitimate marketing lead.

maria-risk: Quick notes: 1) Email uses "+promo" alias on domain that matches patterns we've flagged before. 2) IP 45.77.12.9 is an exit node in a known VPN provider (ASN 39535) and geolocates to NL, not CA. 3) There are 3 recent account creations reusing same credit card prefix and promo attempts within last 24h.

jake-ops: Adding logs for reference — from auth-service at 1772103468: ```WARN auth: promo_apply failed acct_98f3a reason=abuse_risk_high code=402 meta={"ip":"45.77.12.9","ua":"Mozilla/5.0","promo":"SPRINGFREE"}```

sam-support: Customer asked if we can do a manual review. What's our policy for manual trial grants in high-risk flags?

maria-risk: Policy summary: if score>0.8 we require additional verification (company domain email OR documented business affiliation). If customer can provide corporate email (not disposable) or a LinkedIn URL / work email verification, we can consider lowering hold. Manual overrides are rare but allowed for verified enterprise users.

sam-support: Customer offered their LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/julia-marketing). Would that be sufficient?

maria-risk: LinkedIn helps but we need corroboration: matching corporate email or at least a company domain in our allowlist. If they can reply from julia@acme-marketing.com or send a screenshot of company ID via support portal, we can proceed.

sam-support: I'll ask customer to provide corporate email or company proof. They replied: "I can send a company email but I used my personal for signup — can you just grant the trial?"

maria-risk: If they refuse to provide proof, we can't waive risk rules. However we can offer a one-time limited trial on a safe sandbox with quotas (no promo) — but not full promo credits.

jake-ops: If risk team approves a manual override, ops can run temporary grant script. Example admin command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/admin/v1/accounts/acct_98f3a/actions -d '{"action":"grant_trial","amount_cents":5000,"note":"manual override by maria-risk"}'``` Use audit flag.

maria-risk: I can do a manual re-eval after customer provides proof. If they provide corporate email and it passes checks, I'll lower score and sign off.

sam-support: Update for thread: asked customer for corporate email + LinkedIn verification. If they send, we will re-open and mariarisk will triage. Marking P1 because they are on sales path.

(8 minutes later)

sam-support: Customer replied with company email julia@acme-marketing.com and LinkedIn link. Forwarding to @maria-risk for re-eval.

maria-risk: Rechecked records: new email domain acme-marketing.com not in disposable list, IP still VPN exit but acceptable if company email verifies. Lowered risk score to 0.34 after manual checks. I approved a one-time trial grant tied to account with audit note.

jake-ops: Per maria's sign-off — ops executed manual grant at 1772103612. Audit entry: "manual_trial_grant by maria-risk for acct_98f3a; reason: customer provided corporate email + LinkedIn; original risk flags: vpn_exit, promo_reuse"

sam-support: Customer notified and credits applied. They replied :thumbsup: and said thanks. Closing thread, leaving audit notes in ticket.

maria-risk: Reminder to log proof artifacts to ticket and mark as manual override in risk dashboard.

sam-support: Will do. Closing.
